---
name: Feature request

title: "[Feature] "

---

We read every one of these. We can't build everything people ask for, but knowing what you need shapes what we work on next.

Before you write, it's worth checking [docs/features.md](../../docs/features.md). Relay may already do it under a different name.

## What do you wish Relay could do

A sentence or two. Plain language is fine.

## What are you trying to get done

The "why" matters more than the "what." If we understand the job you're doing, we can sometimes point you to a way to do it with what's already there, or design the feature so it helps more people.

For example, "I need last month's invoices exported and emailed to finance on the 1st of every month" tells us the job. "Add a cron field" tells us one possible solution. Both are useful, but the first is more useful.

## How you do it today

Whatever you do instead now, even if it's manual or in another tool. That tells us how much pain the current situation causes.

## How much does it matter to you

Deal-breaker, nice-to-have, or somewhere in between. There's no wrong answer.

## Relay version

Shown under **Settings → Data & Alerts → App updates**.

## Anything else

Mockups, other tools that do this well, related issues. You can drag images straight in.
